info.title: GrowBook garden API
info.summary: Paginated reads and validated writes on the garden registers, plantings and diary.
info.description: Reads are paginated, and writes go through the same validated operations as the interface, with If-Match optimistic locking; evaluations stay read-only. A bearer token carries the same permissions as its owner, so it can create, change and delete records. Text is returned exactly as it was stored, and a null value means it was never recorded. A browsable rendering of this document is served at /api/docs/.
